messages.subject: Quick one - Willow security release
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Unrelated to Ironhold - on the old Project Willow amend-and-extend, Pennine Business Bank's team asked whether the deed of release over the Coventry unit was ever filed. Can someone check the Willow file and confirm? No rush, just closing a loose end for our auditors.

Robert

--
Calverton Industries Limited
Calverton House, Ryebank Road, Redditch B98 8LG
